segment.source: Renders two facing links at the foot of a page, one back to what came before and one on to what comes next, each showing its own title. Use it for: the end of a chapter, a step in a documented process, an article inside a series, an entry in a catalogue, a gallery item. Prefer 'Up Next' when there is only a forward step and it deserves a card of its own, and 'Series Pagination' when the reader should see the whole sequence at once.
